name: Blue Cheese Dressing
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated as blue cheese is aged and low in lactose. Watch for onion/garlic powder in commercial versions.
preparationTips: Check ingredient labels for onion or garlic powder in commercial dressings
Make homemade with aged blue cheese, mayonnaise, and herbs
Use lactose-free sour cream as base if needed
Store refrigerated and use within recommended timeframe
nutritionalHighlights: Healthy fats from olive oil base
